verdict.reasons: The candidate presents a single, clearly recognizable AFP drip-tape carton roll that matches the reference product family. The installed laterals, soil condition, and neutral seedlings support the agonomic irrigation theme without introducing unrelated products or contradictory infrastructure. Branding is legible and consistent with authorized sleeve captions. The deterministic watermark is present and correctly formatted. No core defects identified; minor framing or crop-shape irregularities are within tolerance.

focused_physical_review.reason: A broad, uninterrupted soil gap surrounds the complete footprint of the white-and-blue AFP package. While the nearest installed black irrigation line enters the frame's upper section on the same axis, it passes a short distance in front of the package, clearly separating the line from the package's physical base. The carton sides and base appear completely closed with no visible tape tails, straps, or ribbon strips emerging from the packaging. Exactly one required AFP package is present, and no additional loose uninstalled coils or distinct product objects are visible.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
